cover.coreProposition: Security-sensitive layered configuration must model authority ownership separately from value precedence: when an effective policy gives a credential broker control of provider and startup inputs, lower-trust project configuration should lose that decision surface rather than merely lose a value comparison.
cover.visualMetaphor: A protected amber key held inside a clear boundary while muted project-layer tokens stop outside it
cover.semanticObject: One luminous key and a precise boundary separating admitted from excluded configuration tokens
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with a dominant amber key, deep blue field, restrained geometric layers and strong negative space
